baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three-part sequence هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّاءٍ بِنَمِيمٍ moves from intensive faulting, through repeated movement, to tale-bearing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agent pressures or provokes a damaging formulation, carries it across social relations, and releases speech that an interior should have retained. The three traits therefore operate as one relay rather than as an unordered vice list.

activation_trace.role: Faultfinding and disparagement supply the injurious material entering the relay.
Prodding that sets something in motion gives the first term an initiating force.
Going about with slander makes locomotion the transport stage of the mechanism.
An inside that fails to retain its contents supplies the breached-container model.
Words let out in tale-bearing are the relay's social discharge.

changed_reading.before: A list of three bad traits: a faultfinder, a frequent walker, and a gossip.
changed_reading.after: A serial social mechanism: provoke or compress a fault, carry it between relations, then discharge what should have been held.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The walking and ن م م inventories join movement with faint sound, footfall, or scent that reveals whoever carries it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The carrier tries to expose an absent person, yet the whisper's own movement leaves an index of the carrier. Tale-bearing thus discloses in two directions: referentially toward its target and materially back toward its source.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary movement gives the disclosure a track and a moving source.
A faint sound or motion that gives its maker away makes transmission self-indexing.
A plant betrayed by its scent adds a nonverbal model of a source revealed by what emanates from it.

changed_reading.before: The tale-bearer only exposes the person being discussed.
changed_reading.after: Every carried disclosure also emits a trace that identifies and morally exposes its carrier.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots permit pressure on a letter, an effect walking inside someone, and fine close-set strokes.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rather than transporting one intact report, the agent presses small patterned insinuations into speech; these fragments then spread within hearers and re-pattern perception from the inside.

activation_trace.role: Pressure applied to a spoken letter supplies the micro-articulation stage.
An effect spreading within a person relocates the walking from streets into the hearer's interior.
Fine close-set lines model many small insinuations accumulating into a patterned impression.

changed_reading.before: The carrier repeats a stable piece of gossip from one place to another.
changed_reading.after: The carrier seeds fine verbal strokes whose effect walks inside hearers and gradually alters how a person is seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening pen and aligned lines activate the focus roots' letter-pressure, writing-sound, and fine-stroke branches. Tale-bearing can therefore behave like inscription: a repeatable script that fixes and reproduces insinuation rather than vanishing as casual speech.

activation_trace.role: Pressure on a letter anchors the hostile act in shaped articulation.
An effect spreading inward lets an inscribed formulation continue moving after delivery.
The faint sound of writing links covert disclosure to textual production.
Fine adjacent strokes give rumor a cumulative, reproducible visual form.
The pared writing implement supplies the material means for fixing speech.
An aligned written row supplies ordered replication rather than a one-time utterance.
False stories show written ordering being redeployed as a hostile label.

structural_cues: 68:1 places pen and line-making before the focus portrait.
68:15 later converts recited signs into a dismissive textual category, keeping inscription and hostile relabeling together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, rows, false stories, and focus branches for letter-pressure and fine writing-like traces; I infer that repeated tale-bearing can become a socially portable script. A live alternative is that the writing passages only contrast true and false textual production without specifying the carrier's medium.

changed_reading.after: It can include inscription-like rumor: finely shaped, repeatable formulations that acquire durability and circulate beyond the original encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next portrait couples a barrier against benefit with a root branch for disease passing between bodies. This revises the mobile relay as selective permeability: harmful speech crosses interpersonal limits contagiously while good is stopped at a gate.

activation_trace.role: A prod initiates the harmful transfer.
Movement carries the transfer across social boundaries.
Released words are the transmissible material.
A barrier between a person and what is sought supplies the blocked-benefit side of the permeability model.
Disease transfer supplies the surprising contagion image for speech crossing from host to host.

structural_cues: The mobile leakage of 68:11 is immediately followed by obstruction of good and transgression in 68:12.
The juxtaposition permits a one-way gate: injury circulates while benefit is withheld.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies motion, leaked speech, a barrier, and contagious transfer; I supply the arrow that treats them as one selective social membrane. They may instead remain independent traits in a cumulative portrait.

changed_reading.before: The tale-bearer manually carries discrete reports.
changed_reading.after: The tale-bearer operates a contagious boundary regime: injury propagates across relations while access to benefit is actively blocked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence realizes movement plus low speech as group logistics: they set out, whisper, formulate a no-entry rule, and end deprived. The focus phrase now names covert communication used to synchronize exclusion, not merely gossip consumed for amusement.

activation_trace.role: Walking with covert reports supplies the focus-level coordination channel.
Low sound and footfall make secrecy operational yet detectible.
Setting out without restraint supplies coordinated group motion.
Lowered secret speech supplies the coalition's private command channel.
Entry into an interior supplies the access point the whispered plan closes.
Missing the sought outcome supplies the plan's reflexive endpoint in deprivation.

structural_cues: 68:23-24 tightly sequences departure, mutual whispering, and a prohibition on entry.
68:27 reverses the intended exclusion: the planners name themselves deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group motion, secret speech, a no-entry formulation, and deprivation; I infer that the whisper coordinates the exclusion and that its mechanism returns on the group. The live alternative is simple narrative succession without a claim about tale-bearing as infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns someone who passes private remarks between individuals.
changed_reading.after: It also exposes covert speech as operational infrastructure by which a group aligns movement, polices access, and produces exclusion that can rebound on the group.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's self-revealing trace is materialized by later attachment, bodily marking, exposed defect, and covering shame. Speech used to mark absent others carries a signature that can attach to and publicly mark its own carrier.

activation_trace.role: Assigning faults to people is the outward marking action.
A slight movement that identifies its source makes the marking action traceable back to the carrier.
An emanating scent that reveals its plant gives self-identification a second sensory model.
A conspicuous hanging appendage materializes a label that remains attached.
The nose supplies the visible bodily surface on which the returning trace is located.
A defect becoming exposed supplies the public reversal from revealer to revealed.
An overpowering covering supplies the shame that overtakes the exposed agent.

structural_cues: The uncitable و س م occurrence in 68:16 is used only as the structural act of placing a mark; no branch identity is asserted for it.
68:42-43 reverses hidden maneuver into exposed defect and visible humiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-revealing traces, an attached appendage, a structural marking act on the nose, exposure, and overtaking shame; I infer a return path from the carrier's disclosure to the carrier's own public mark. The alternative is an eschatological reversal unrelated to the material mechanics of 68:11.

changed_reading.before: The carrier marks other people with faults while remaining outside the report.
changed_reading.after: The carrier's own route, whisper, and emanation form a signature, so the act of marking others becomes self-marking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogation about judgment, book, guarantor, unseen knowledge, and writing turns the relay into unauthorized adjudication. Fine fragments about an absent person are not merely repeated; they are arranged until an uncertain claim functions socially like a record or verdict.

activation_trace.role: Fault assignment supplies the accusation being adjudicated.
Released words move the accusation into public circulation.
Fine adjacent strokes model fragments arranged until they resemble a coherent record.
Judgment between people supplies the social force the rumor illegitimately imitates.
A written proof that imposes a ruling supplies the conversion from report into putative authority.
Speech made without certainty identifies the evidentiary weakness beneath the apparent verdict.
Mentioning a person in absence supplies the characteristic target condition of the relay.
Ordered letters fix an unseen claim into a durable-seeming statement.

structural_cues: 68:36-40 repeatedly challenges the source of a judgment through questions about a book, study, oath, and guarantor.
68:47 joins possession of the unseen to writing, exposing the unsupported leap from hidden matter to fixed claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faulting, fine strokes, absent-person mention, uncertain assertion, judgment, and writing with binding force; I infer that the carrier manufactures pseudo-evidence by arranging fragments. The alternative is that the legal questions refute a different class of claims and only analogically illuminate 68:11.

changed_reading.before: Gossip is an informal report with no institutional force.
changed_reading.after: The carrier acts as a shadow court, converting uncertain speech about absent people into a record-like social verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Degree-by-degree taking from an obscure place, prolonged through delay, temporalizes the focus's walking. Small disclosures need not strike once; they can advance by increments until the hearer or target has been moved without noticing the route.

activation_trace.role: Walking supplies the stepwise substrate for incremental movement.
An effect spreading inside someone supplies the unnoticed interior advance.
A barely perceptible sound or movement supplies increments small enough to evade notice.
Taking by successive degrees gives the relay a cumulative temporal architecture.
An indeterminate location hides the route from which the increments arrive.
Extended time and respite supply the duration in which small effects accumulate.

structural_cues: 68:44 explicitly combines gradual movement with lack of awareness.
68:45 extends the process rather than resolving it immediately.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive degrees, an obscure source, delay, and focus branches for walking and inward spread; I infer an incremental persuasion or reputational-capture process. The agency in 68:44 is different, so this remains a structural analogy rather than a moral equivalence.

changed_reading.before: The carrier damages through repeated but discrete encounters.
changed_reading.after: The carrier can move a hearer or target by nearly invisible increments, allowing insinuation to accumulate into displacement over time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between an interior that retains nothing, disciplined self-restraint, and a filled outlet held shut reframes نَمِيم as a boundary-regulation failure. The context also prevents a simple equation of virtue with silence: restraint and pathological choking remain distinct live states.

activation_trace.role: An inside unable to keep its contents supplies the leaking extreme.
Words discharged as tale-bearing specify the ethically harmful release.
Holding the self back from panic supplies deliberate, governed containment.
Anger retained inside supplies affective pressure that has not been released.
A full outlet sealed shut supplies the opposite extreme of overcontainment.

structural_cues: 68:48 places the command to endure beside the warning example of a constrained, distressed caller.
The focus and context therefore stage both uncontrolled leakage and dangerous internal pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed retention, harmful release, deliberate restraint, and a sealed full outlet; I infer an ethics of governing the interior-to-public boundary. A live alternative is that مَكْظُومٌ only describes distress, so it warns against choking rather than supplying a positive containment pole.

changed_reading.before: The vice is simply saying bad things.
changed_reading.after: The vice is a malformed regulation of what crosses from interior to public: malicious leakage is condemned, disciplined restraint is possible, and total choking is not automatically idealized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene converts reception into hostile output and displacement: a reminder is heard, an allegation is spoken, and sight is weaponized to make the target lose footing. The focus's walking can thus reside in the signal as it crosses hearing, speech, and gaze, while the person targeted is the one socially moved.

activation_trace.role: Impelling pressure supplies the hostile force applied to the target.
Movement supplies the transfer across sensory and social channels.
Slander-bearing as movement identifies the transmitted output.
Words released as accusation form the verbal leg of the circuit.
Loss of stable footing supplies the circuit's intended displacement of the target.
Physical sight supplies a nonverbal channel through which hostility is projected.
Auditory reception supplies the input stage that precedes hostile conversion.
Something brought into present awareness specifies what is received before being recoded.
Attributing what is not so supplies the hostile recoding into allegation.
The accusation of reason being covered supplies the stigmatizing label attached to the target.

structural_cues: The temporal لما ties the hostile response to hearing the reminder.
The verse joins gaze, hearing, saying, labeling, and attempted loss of footing in one compact scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory reception, spoken false attribution, visual pressure, and displacement; I infer a conversion circuit continuous with the focus's mobile tale-bearing. The alternative is that 68:51 depicts a separate collective reaction and only repeats the earlier label.

changed_reading.before: مَشَّاء describes only the carrier's feet moving between people.
changed_reading.after: The walking also belongs to the hostile signal as it migrates from hearing to speech to gaze, while its target is pressured out of stable social footing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final universal remembrance prevents movement and voiced circulation from being condemned in themselves. The focus names a deforming circuit because fault-pressure and breached confidence govern what moves; remembrance offers a coexisting circulation that preserves and re-presents rather than covertly weaponizes.

activation_trace.role: Faulting people supplies the harmful orientation that distinguishes the focus circuit.
An effect spreading within hearers is ethically open until its content and relation are specified.
Betraying speech specifies the harmful mode of release rather than release as such.
Restoring something to awareness supplies a preservative alternative to deforming disclosure.
Remembrance running on the tongue supplies open vocal circulation rather than covert relay.

structural_cues: 68:52 gives remembrance an explicitly universal destination.
The closure follows immediately after hostile hearing and labeling, preserving two opposed uses of circulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies betrayed speech, inward spread, remembrance on the tongue, and universal scope; I infer that the ethical distinction lies in what circulation does to truth and persons. The alternative is a simple contrast of message content with the accusation in 68:51.

changed_reading.before: Repeated movement and widespread speech are intrinsically suspect.
changed_reading.after: Circulation remains ethically bifurcated: covert fault-bearing deforms persons, while open remembrance can preserve and awaken across the widest audience.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads social speech through friction mechanics rather than using a lexical gloss. It remains anchored in the focus's prod-movement-release sequence and in context branches for accommodation, smooth travel, oiling, and loss of footing. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for how rumor eases its route while destabilizing a target, not as the direct meaning of any one word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَشَّاء stands between a prodding هَمَّاز and discharged نَمِيم, allowing movement to be read in terms of how resistance is managed.

activation_trace.role: The prod supplies local pressure against the person being targeted.
Movement supplies a route whose friction can be increased or reduced.
Released words are what the smoothed route carries.
Soft accommodation supplies the interpersonal method for lowering resistance with the current listener.
A smooth road literalizes ease of passage for the report.
A surface on which footing fails supplies the target's destabilized endpoint.
Oiling and polishing reinforce the cross-context friction image.

changed_reading.before: The carrier simply walks a message from source to recipient.
changed_reading.after: The carrier manages social friction: accommodating the listener and smoothing the message's route while prodding and destabilizing the absent target.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the growth, livestock, and offspring side of م ش ي beside wealth and sons. It remains anchored in the focus root and in the immediately following resource-lineage context, where fine insinuations can be imagined as multiplying through a supported network. Downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory model of rumor's reproduction and social backing, not as a lexical equation of gossip with wealth or children.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The م ش ي inventory includes increase and abundant offspring as well as inward spread, while ن م م includes many fine adjacent marks.

activation_trace.role: Growth, abundant offspring, and property supply a reproductive rather than merely locomotive model of spread.
An effect spreading within people gives the reproduced units somewhere to take hold.
Numerous fine close-set strokes model small units multiplying into a larger social pattern.
Accumulated wealth supplies backing that can extend the reach and persistence of a speaker's network.
Lineage and attribution to an origin supply a model for reports reproducing while retaining a social source.
Small offshoots from a parent thing supply the branching units of repeated insinuation.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and sons are unrelated background advantages of the described person.
changed_reading.after: Resources and lineage may function as reproductive social capital through which small insinuations branch, multiply, and acquire persistence.

strongest_changes: The focus became a causal relay: fault-pressure, social transport, and breached containment.
The garden sequence changed private gossip into covert coordination that governs access and can reverse into deprivation.
The judgment-book-guarantor-unseen sequence changed rumor into pseudo-evidence and unauthorized adjudication about absent people.
The closing sensory scene moved مَشَّاء from the carrier's feet into a transmodal signal that converts hearing into allegation, gaze pressure, and target displacement.
The patience and constriction contrast reframed the vice as failed regulation of the interior-to-public boundary while preserving a warning against overcontainment.
summary.what_was_special: The unusually rich ن م م inventory opened several coexisting axes that a generic 'gossip' gloss would hide: an inside that retains nothing, writing-sound and fine lines, faint movement that betrays its source, and emanation that reveals what produced it. Those axes allowed oral relay, inscription, contagion, covert logistics, pseudo-judgment, self-marking, and counter-circulation to remain distinct rather than collapsing into one moral paraphrase.
remaining_uncertainties: Several causal arrows join adjacent descriptions or narrative stages that could instead be independent accumulations.
The written, contagious, lubricated-route, incremental-capture, and reproductive models are branch-grounded analogies, not direct lexical glosses.
The self-marking reversal depends partly on using the missing و س م inventory only as an uncited structural cue.
68:48 sustains a real tension: restraint can govern release, while constriction can also become pathological pressure.
68:52 may establish an ethical alternative mode of circulation, or may only contrast the reminder's content with the hostile accusation in 68:51.
